Only methods declared in candy-image/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\CandyImage

Cli final class

Command-line entry point: parse argv, detect the terminal (or honor the explicit --format), decode the image through sugar-image, and write the rendered bytes to stdout.

MethodSummary
static runningVersion(): stringThe version this run reports: the phar archive's build stamp when executing inside one (InstalledVersions lies under the frozen vendor/), else what Composer's install metadata says the package IS, else the compiled-in VERSION constant. The archive is identified by \Phar::running(false), which is exactly the real path the \Phar constructor wants here (the class file only ever runs when required from inside the archive, never as the stub itself).
static main(array $argv, $stdout, $stderr, ?\Closure $play = null): intRun the viewer front end.
static workDialToFactor(string $raw): ?floatchafa's --work normalization. The option is an INTeger 1..9 (G_OPTION_ARG_INT at tools/chafa/ chicle-options.c:1989, range check :2420) mapped onto the config float (N−1)/8 (tools/chafa/chafa.c:570): --work=1 is the CHEAPEST render (0.0 → chafa's 1-candidate window), --work=9 the most exhaustive (1.0 → the >= 8 slow path). Decimals, 0, 10+ and junk all return null — the caller reports the usage error, exactly where chafa's own parser bails.
static viewportCells(): arraySize the render box to the terminal viewport (cols, rows-1 status allowance for the animate path). The ladder mirrors sugar-core's PosixBackend::size(): size ioctl on a live tty, then COLUMNS/LINES, then the fixed 60x24 fallback (piped/CI carries no signal).
static shouldArmConsoleCodepage(bool $isWindows, bool $isTty): boolArm-selection predicate for the Windows console codepage fix (candy-image-023): the output page only needs arming to UTF-8 when the process actually runs on Windows AND is writing to a console. A piped redirected file has no console codepage to speak of, so a tty is part of the contract. Public so the truth table is pinned in-process on every platform, not only on the Windows runner.

Lang final class

Per-package translation facade for candy-image.

SugarCraft\CandyImage\Support

Version final class

Reads the version stamped into a running phar archive's metadata.

MethodSummary
static resolve(string $archive, string $fallback): stringResolve the version for the current run.
static fromPharMetadata(string $archivePath): ?stringRead and normalize the version stamp inside an archive, or null when the path is empty, is not a file, is not a readable phar, or its stamp does not parse as either a comparable release or a recognized development identity. Every failure mode falls back to null rather than throwing — a corrupt archive must not crash --version.
static normalizeStamp(string $stamped): ?stringNormalize a build stamp to a printable version, or null when it names neither a comparable release nor a recognized development identity: TAG_PREFIX stripped, a leading v stripped, then the COMPARABLE release shape, then the DEV grammar. One grammar, one home — the reader above delegates here so every arm is testable without minting an archive (tests/Support/VersionTest.php pins the matrix, plus a real-stamp round-trip through the reader).
